data.name: Aadilat
data.gender_notes: Aadilat is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Just women; fair and equitable (feminine plural)
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿādilāt (عادلات), the feminine plural of ʿādil 'just, fair', from the root ʿ-d-l (justice). Aadilat therefore means “Just women; fair and equitable (feminine plural)”. Arabic feminine plural ʿādilāt 'just (f. pl.)'; from the root ʿ-d-l.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aadilat expresses “Just”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿādilāt (عادلات), the feminine plural of ʿādil 'just, fair', from the root ʿ-d-l (justice).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadilat total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

faq.a: Aadilat (عادلات) is the feminine plural of ʿādil 'just', so it literally means 'just women'. It is used as a girl's name.

faq.q: What does the name Aadilat mean?
faq.a: Aadilat means “Just women; fair and equitable (feminine plural)”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aadilat come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aadilat?
faq.a: The root of Aadilat is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: How is Aadilat written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aadilat is written عادلات in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aadilat a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadilat is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aadilat appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aadilat is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aadilat verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Just women; fair and equitable (feminine plural)” is established by Arabic feminine plural ʿādilāt 'just (f. pl.)'; from the root ʿ-d-l..
